qa_pairs.question: What is the recommended hole diameter to drill when preparing connections for spot welding?
qa_pairs.answer: 8 mm (0.316") dia. holes with same spacing as the drilled out welded spots in connections not accessible for the spot welding tongs.

qa_pairs.question: What precaution should be taken when grinding welded seams?
qa_pairs.answer: Don't grind down the sheet metal too thin. Straighten and tin out irregularities, with tinning out supposed to prepare the surface so that only a coat of fine filler has to be applied prior to spraying on paint.

qa_pairs.question: How should brazed connections be produced to minimize heat damage?
qa_pairs.answer: Produce brazed connections with as little as possible heat dispersion and without excessive heat. Procedures deviating from standard connections will be described in the repair manual.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with residual brazing solder after heating connections?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove residual brazing solder with a steel brush. Straighten and grind all connection points thoroughly.

qa_pairs.question: What is the first step when cutting out damaged parts?
qa_pairs.answer: Determine the location of mating surfaces with help of the replacement part before beginning with the work. Cut out damaged part roughly within the mating surfaces.

qa_pairs.question: What material should be used to coat mating surfaces intended for resistance spot welding?
qa_pairs.answer: Coat mating surfaces intended for resistance spot welding with zinc dust paint.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done immediately after repairing welding seams that were originally sealed?
qa_pairs.answer: Seal off all welding seams, which had been sealed in original state, with a body sealing compound immediately after repairing.

qa_pairs.question: What caution is given regarding sheet metal underneath when cutting?
qa_pairs.answer: Don't damage sheet metal located underneath.

qa_pairs.question: What should be removed from the neutral body points before drilling?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove sealing compound, anti-drumming compound and, if applicable, paint to neutralize the connection points. Drill out spot welding.

qa_pairs.question: Who is listed as the source of supply for workshop equipment and materials?
qa_pairs.answer: HWB (a Business Division of BMW AG).

qa_pairs.question: What specific repairs should always be performed regarding suspension and drivetrain mounting points?
qa_pairs.answer: Always perform repairs, which concern the suspension points of the engine, transmission, axles or running gear, or a straightening bench with the attachments belonging to the car type.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done when installing new sheet metal parts regarding sealing compounds?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace damaged anti-drumming compound. Seal new sheet metal parts or the cavities, seams and folds produced by new sheet metal parts with a body cavity sealing compound immediately.
